rule: The panel contains multiple documents describing overlapping real-world quantities. Never mix granularities when summing: (a) within a fiscal year use EITHER all monthly documents OR the annual document, never both; (b) Table IX/X (country) and XI/XII/XIII (district) are the same measure along different dimensions — pick one dimension, do not sum across them; (c) pre-approval (channel_class=measure) is a distinct stage, not a deployment channel. Each row carries `granularity` (month|year|measure) and `reconciled_fiscal_year`; deduplicate on the `dedup_key` below.

files.panel_canonical.csv.gz: PRIMARY, additive-only: row_type=detail AND channel_class=component. Summing it cannot double-count an aggregate against its components. Filter analysis_safe=true for the safe default.
files.panel_rollup.csv.gz: Non-additive companion: channel_class=aggregate rows, printed total/grand_total rows and measure rows. Compare against the primary; never add to it.

entity_uniqueness.resolved: name_canonical is the canonical entity name (countries.json / districts.json).
entity_uniqueness.unresolved: Unresolved entities carry entity_resolved=false. Source-clipped names (doc 332 'Republic o' x4, 'REPUBLI') are suffixed with their source serial, e.g. 'Republic o (sn 9)', so name_canonical is unique and a groupby never silently merges different countries. The four clipped Republics are unrecoverable from the PDF text layer (verified).
entity_uniqueness.key_note: dedup_key alone is sufficient for resolved rows; unresolved rows are additionally keyed by (doc_id, sn) at reconcile time as a belt-and-suspenders guard.

granularity._measure_override: rows with channel_class=='measure' are 'measure' regardless of doc_type

overrides.evidence: Table X recruiting-agency total 208,351 equals Table XIII (printed 2018/19) 208,349, while Table XI (printed 2017/18) 323,877 equals Table IX 323,876.
overrides.note: The report repeats Table IX's header year on Table X; the data is FY2018/19 (2075/76). Raw period columns are left as printed; only reconciled_fiscal_year changes.

overlap_groups.note: All 12 months present; annual 278 is their roll-up (annual total_with_reentry 1,584,374 vs months 1,584,406 — small source revisions). Use one series or the other.
